content.title: 10 Million Duroods A Tearful Conclusion: May This Love of the Ummah Never Ends.
content.subtitle: A heartfelt plea to every soul united in love for the Prophet ﷺ
content.body:
There are emotions that words can never fully carry. Gazing toward the Green Dome of Madinah, a believer feels a longing deep within the heart that knows no language. Miles of desert may separate our bodies from Madinah, but whenever our eyes fill with tears at the remembrance of the Beloved Prophet ﷺ, every distance seems to disappear.

A Flood of Love That Touched Hearts

Love for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ is among the greatest treasures of a believer. It was with this love in our hearts that our journey of sending Durood began.

Our intention was never simply to complete a challenge or reach a number. In the midst of our increasingly mechanical and hurried lives, we wanted people to pause for a moment, reconnect with their love for the Prophet ﷺ, and nurture a deeper spiritual bond with Madinah.

For those who rarely found time to send Durood, and for those who recited it but had not yet made it a daily habit, our deepest hope was that this blessed journey would leave a lasting Durood upon their tongues.

A Blessed Journey That Reached Its Goal Early

We thought the target might be reached slowly, over the full course of the campaign. But the river of love flowing through countless hearts surpassed every expectation.

The original goal of 10 million Duroods was completed three days ahead of schedule. And today, on the final day of the campaign, the total has reached approximately 14.2 million Duroods, with nearly 42,000 people joining this blessed caravan of love.

These numbers are not merely numbers. They are the collective longing of thousands of hearts, sending their humble gifts of love toward Madinah from afar. We do not know how much this small effort will ultimately achieve. But if, through this campaign, even a few people have made Durood a permanent part of their daily lives, we believe every effort has been worthwhile.

View the full campaign results and detailed statistics here: https://campaign.muslimsday.com/durud-sept-26/en

On This Blessed Friday, We Make Our Final Dua

Today our Durood campaign officially comes to an end. But may the melody that has touched our tongues never fall silent.

To everyone who joined this journey, encouraged others, and carried this message of love forward, may Allah accept your efforts and make these Duroods a means of receiving the intercession of the Beloved Prophet ﷺ on the Day when we will need it most.

The Campaign Ends. The Love Continues.

Muslims Day hopes to make the spiritual journey of every believer more meaningful in this age of technology. Your prayers, love, and continued support will remain our greatest strength as we bring more heart-softening and faith-strengthening initiatives to you.

footer_button.hint: The campaign may be ending today, but may your love for the Prophet ﷺ continue throughout your life. In the rush of daily life, never let Durood slip from your tongue. Turn on the Durood Reminder in the Muslims Day app, and let it gently remind you throughout the day. Keep your tongue moist with Durood. Keep your heart connected to Madinah.
